key.name: model
key.description: The id of the model to use, from /usr/share/kulan-assistant/models.json.

key.name: writing-tools
key.description: Proofread, rewrite or shorten the text you selected in any app (Shift+Super+W).

key.name: file-summaries
key.description: "Summarise" when you right-click a document in Files.

key.name: live-text-actions
key.summary: Translate and explain after Live Text
key.description: Buttons on the Live Text notification to translate or explain the text that was copied.

key.name: question-search
key.description: Find files from a question typed in Activities, such as "the invoice from last month".

key.name: translate-to
key.description: Language name for translations; empty means the computer's language.

key.name: dictation
key.description: Press Shift+Super+D, speak, press it again: the words are typed where the cursor is.

key.name: dictation-model
key.description: The id of the speech model, from /usr/share/kulan-assistant/models.json.

key.name: dictation-language
key.description: Two-letter code of the language you speak; empty means detect it each time.

key.name: keep-conversations
key.description: Keep Ask Kulan's conversations on this computer, so you can go back to them. Off: nothing is saved.
